headlines.title: Map: See how gas prices have changed in the county where you live
headlines.description: How much gas prices have increased during the Iran war depends entirely on where you live, an NBC News analysis of average gas price data from AAA shows.

headlines.title: How Personal Finance is Changing for Younger Generations
headlines.description: From saving for retirement to talking openly about money, Yanely Espinal, Next Gen personal finance director of educational outreach, joins TODAY to share how to navigate personal finances in today’s world. Her tips include opening a high-yield savings account, reverse budgeting, diversifying income and more.

headlines.title: What’s Old is New Again! Estate Sales Rise in Popularity
headlines.description: A new generation is driving a huge surge in estate sales with searches for “how to find estate sales near me” up 60% this year according to Google. The competition to find value is brisk and in some cases, people are signing up to attend a sale, days in advance. NBC’s Christine Romans reports for TODAY with a deep dive into the booming business and its appeal for young people.

headlines.title: White House withholding $289 million of small business loans
headlines.description: The Trump administration is withholding $289 million appropriated by Congress for loans to small businesses. The elimination came through an executive order last year, with President Trump saying the program was "woke" and promoted "gender extremism" and "climate radicalism." NBC News senior financial reporter Gretchen Morgenson details the reasons for the pause and how damaging the move could be for Main Street.

headlines.title: Target facing backlash over children's clown costume
headlines.description: Target is facing backlash over its sale of a children's clown costume which some consumers said resembled racist caricatures of Black people. The company pulled the costume from its stores and issued a statement saying it was "deeply sorry."

headlines.title: Kevin Warsh walks a fine line on inflation in key speech
headlines.description: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh said measures of inflation are still elevated, but it is not yet clear that the Fed must take action to address rising prices.

headlines.title: ‘Big questions’ and few easy answers for Fed chair at annual retreat
headlines.description: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s speech at the bank’s Jackson Hole retreat offers him a chance to outline an inflation strategy and boost his credibility.

headlines.title: Map: How much you pay in federal and state gas taxes
headlines.description: As national gas price averages head toward $5 per gallon, one state has already suspended its gas tax, and now President Donald Trump and his Cabinet are talking about doing the same.

headlines.title: Meta agrees to settle social media addiction claims with states for up to $18 billion
headlines.description: Meta Platforms, the owner of Facebook and Instagram has agreed to settle a series of social media addiction claims for up to $18 billion.

headlines.title: Oil prices dip as cautious optimism over Iran trumps new fears of Russian escalation in Ukraine
headlines.description: Oil prices tumbled as headlines from the Middle East renewed optimism in global energy markets, and muted fears of a Russian escalation in Ukraine.

headlines.title: Panda Express’ CEOs are on a ‘mission’ to help workers achieve the dream of home ownership
headlines.description: Panda Express founders Andrew and Peggy Cherng want to be known for helping their workers build careers and eventually buy their own homes.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.
